title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: overflow actions for direct inward dialed calls
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly describes inbound profiles as deciding who has a direct number, although number assignment is a prerequisite. It also overlooks the documented API for updating stored playbook prompts; the rollout facts and core overflow behaviour are supported.

claims.claim: Direct inward dialed calls reach a representative's personal number rather than a main line or queue.

claims.claim: An administrator-defined playbook automatically runs the fallback action matching a direct-call condition.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The direct-call template is reached in Copilot Service admin center through Customer support > Conversation Orchestration > Prompt gallery > Overflow handling > Handle overflow for direct inbound call.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Open questions: API
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an API for the playbook control.
claims.quote: Update ... PATCH /msdyn_ccuserprompts(msdyn_ccuserpromptid) ... Writable columns/attributes ... msdyn_exclusionlist ... msdyn_inclusionlist ... msdyn_prompt
claims.fix: Replace the blanket API absence with rest call 'PATCH /msdyn_ccuserprompts(msdyn_ccuserpromptid)' and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/developer/reference/entities/msdyn_ccuserprompt. Note: 'The request body can update msdyn_prompt, the stored playbook prompt. This reference does not document executing publication or the format of inbound-profile scope lists.' The orchestration page explicitly identifies CC User Prompt as the playbook component in its migration instructions. Replace the API open question with 'Will Microsoft document an operation to publish a direct-call playbook through an API?' Do not claim that changing a status column publishes a playbook.

claims.fix: Print 'Support experience > Productivity > Outbound and inbound profiles (Manage)' to retain the documented button label, and clarify in the note: 'This route opens the profile list; select New profile and the Inbound profile type to create an inbound profile, or select an existing profile and Edit.'
